Name: Sam and the Great Haircut (Portrait and Character mod)
Author: trueweevil
Description:
A note: Several people have contacted me to ask for permission to use my mod as part of their own mods (as well as some people who've used it without asking but still credited me), and I've said yes every time, so I think it's time to officially say a blanket ✨yes✨ - anyone is welcome to use this mod to include in their own mod as long as I am credited in the upload description. [url=https://emojipedia.org/smiling-face-with-smiling-eyes/]?[/url] Thank you all for the love on this mod over the years!

This is my gift to the Stardew community, you lovely people. Please enjoy this sprite edit package I have made.

The zip includes fully-edited XML spritesheets for both the Portrait and Character folders.

Note: I haven’t uploaded this anywhere else on the web, so other uploads are RUDE and might be dodgy. Stay safe.
